search.typeName: Type a name, or pick one
detail.noEnvYet: No .env yet. One will be created, readable by you alone.
name.replace: has a value · will be replaced
name.replaceIn: has a value in %1 · will be replaced
git.tracked: tracked by git: would be committed
git.otherVcs: under %1, which this plugin does not check
confirm.replace.title: Replace the value in %1
confirm.replace.sub: It already has a value there. The old one is not kept.
confirm.ignore.title: Add %1 to .gitignore in %2
confirm.ignore.sub: git does not ignore it there today, so the key could be committed.
confirm.vcs.title: Not checked: %1
confirm.vcs.sub: This plugin only checks git. Keeping the file out of that system is yours to do.
result.clip.cleared.title: Clipboard cleared
result.clip.cleared.sub: The key is no longer on it.
result.clip.changed.title: Clipboard left alone
result.clip.changed.sub: Something newer had been copied since.
result.clip.failed.title: Clipboard STILL HOLDS THE KEY
result.clip.failed.sub: It could not be cleared. Copy something else over it.
result.clip.unused.title: Clipboard not used
result.clip.unused.sub: The key went from one file to the other.
result.history.removed.title: Removed from clipboard history

result.history.removed.sub.one: %1 entry removed. Every other entry is untouched.
result.history.removed.sub.other: %1 entries removed. Every other entry is untouched.

result.history.none.title: Clipboard history had no copy of it
result.history.none.sub: Looked, and found nothing to remove.
result.history.noFile.title: No clipboard history on this machine
result.history.noFile.sub: There was no history file to look in.
result.history.unchecked.title: Clipboard history NOT checked
result.history.unchecked.sub: It could not be read or safely edited. Open it (Super+Ctrl+V) and delete the entry.
result.failed.title: Nothing was written
result.failed.status: The helper exited with status %1 and no report.
result.detail.never: The key was never shown, typed or put in a command.
result.detail.agents: Agents read it from the project's .env, as before.
error.cannot-write: Cannot write %1: the file or its folder is read-only.
error.tracked: git already tracks %1, so a key saved there would be committed. Stop tracking it first, with git rm --cached.
error.not-ignored: git does not ignore %1, so the key could be committed. Add it to .gitignore, then save again.
error.not-found: The key could not be read from %1.
error.no-key: The clipboard does not hold something that looks like a key.
keys.none: No keys found in the search folders.
places.send.title: Send to another project
places.send.sub: Copied from this file straight into the other. The clipboard is not used.
places.copy.title: Copy to the clipboard
places.copy.sub: Marked sensitive, so clipboard history keeps no copy. Paste it where it is needed.
places.nothingToSend: There is no value in %1 to send.
places.nothingToCopy: There is no value in %1 to copy.
copy.failed.title: Not copied
copy.failed.sub: The clipboard could not be reached.
copy.done.title: Copied %1
copy.done.body: On the clipboard, marked sensitive. Clipboard history keeps no copy.
folders.add.title: + Add a folder
folders.depth.title: Depth: %1
folders.depth.sub: How many folders down to look for a project nested inside another.
folders.detail.what: Every folder directly inside a search folder is a project. Deeper folders count when they hold a .env.
folders.detail.skipped: Hidden folders and dependency folders such as node_modules are skipped.

browse.detail.one: Tab adds this folder to the search. Its %1 sub-folder becomes a project.
browse.detail.other: Tab adds this folder to the search. Its %1 sub-folders become projects.

notice.noKey.title: No key on the clipboard
notice.noKey.how: Press Copy on the site that shows the key, then press this hotkey again.
peek.lines: The clipboard holds several lines, which is not a key.
peek.spaces: The clipboard holds text with spaces in it, which is not a key.
peek.quote: The clipboard holds something with a single quote in it, which a .env file cannot carry safely.
peek.short: The clipboard holds fewer than 8 characters, which is too short to be a key.
peek.unreadable: The clipboard could not be read.
notice.tracked.title: git already tracks %1
notice.tracked.why: A key saved there would be committed, and adding the file to .gitignore would not change that.
notice.tracked.fix: Stop tracking it first, with git rm --cached, then save again.
empty.typeName: Type a name for the key.
notify.copyNow.title: Copy %1 now
notify.copyNow.body: Waiting %1 seconds. It will be saved to %2.
notify.gaveUp.title: Gave up waiting for %1
notify.gaveUp.body: Nothing that looks like a key was copied.
notify.saved.title: Saved %1
notify.clip.changed: clipboard left alone, it had already changed
notify.history.no-file: no clipboard history on this machine
